function.name: search_video
function.description: Searches for videos based on a query. It reveals user interests and preferences based on the search terms.

query.description: The search term or keyword used to find videos.

filters.description: Additional filters for refining search results (e.g., date range, view count).

limit.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: update_profile
function.description: Updates user profile information, including personal data like username, email, and preferences.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose profile is being updated.

new_username.description: New username to be set for the user.

new_email.description: New email address to be associated with the user's account.

new_profile_picture.description: A new profile picture to be uploaded. (file path or URL)

privacy_settings.description: The updated privacy settings (e.g., public, private).

function.name: upload_video
function.description: Uploads a video to the platform. Involves personal information (like account details) and may have copyright implications.

video_file.description: The video file to be uploaded.

privacy_settings.description: Privacy settings for the video (e.g., public, private, unlisted).

description.description: A brief description of the video content.

function.name: view_watch_history
function.description: Retrieves the user's watch history, potentially revealing personal preferences and interests.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user whose watch history is being queried.

limit.description: Number of history entries to return (e.g., last 10 watched videos).

function.name: post_comment
function.description: Allows a user to post a comment on a video. This reveals personal opinions and social interactions.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video to comment on.

user_id.description: The identifier of the user posting the comment.

function.name: share_video
function.description: Shares a video via a link or embedded code. This involves social interaction and the possibility of spreading personal content.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video to be shared.

platform.description: The platform where the video is being shared (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, email).

share_method.description: The method of sharing (e.g., link, embed).

function.name: like_dislike_video
function.description: Allows the user to like or dislike a video, revealing personal preferences and affecting video recommendations.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video to like or dislike.

user_id.description: The identifier of the user performing the action.

action.description: The action to be performed (either 'like' or 'dislike').
